title: Cross-modal RAG: Sub-dimensional Text-to-Image Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2505.21956v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Text-to-image generation increasingly demands access to domain-specific, fine-grained, and rapidly evolving knowledge that pretrained models cannot fully capture, necessitating the integration of retrieval methods. Existing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) methods attempt to address this by retrieving globally relevant images, but they fail when no single image contains all desired elements from a complex user query. We propose Cross-modal RAG, a novel framework that decomposes both queries and images into sub-dimensional components, enabling subquery-aware retrieval and generation. Our method introduces a hybrid retrieval strategy, combining a sub-dimensional sparse retriever with a dense retriever, to identify a Pareto-optimal set of images, each contributing complementary aspects of the query. translated_title: 跨模态RAG：子维度文本到图像检索增强生成
translated_abstract: 文本到图像生成日益需要访问特定领域、细粒度且快速演进的知识，而预训练模型无法完全涵盖这些知识，因此需要引入检索方法。现有的检索增强生成（RAG）方法试图通过检索全局相关的图像来解决这一问题，但当没有单一图像能够包含复杂用户查询中的所有所需元素时，这些方法便会失效。我们提出了跨模态RAG（Cross-modal RAG），这是一种新颖的框架，它将查询和图像均分解为子维度组件，从而实现子查询感知的检索与生成。我们的方法引入了一种混合检索策略，将子维度稀疏检索器与稠密检索器相结合，以识别出帕累托最优的图像集合，其中每张图像都贡献了查询的互补方面。在生成过程中，多模态大语言模型被引导选择性地以与特定子查询对齐的相关视觉特征为条件。
tldr: 提出跨模态RAG框架，通过将查询和图像分解为子维度组件，并结合稀疏与稠密混合检索策略识别帕累托最优图像集合，实现子查询感知的检索增强文本到图像生成。
en_tdlr: Proposes Cross-modal RAG, a framework that decomposes queries and images into sub-dimensional components and employs a hybrid sparse-dense retrieval strategy to identify a Pareto-optimal set of images, enabling subquery-aware retrieval-augmented text-to-image generation.
